facts.subject: Tray unavailable error code
facts.value: ERR_TRAY_UNAVAILABLE — emitted when no system tray is present; app must degrade gracefully without orphaning a resident process

facts.subject: Notification permission denied error code
facts.value: ERR_NOTIFICATION_DENIED — OS notification permission denied; no error loop, session state remains visible on manual restore

facts.subject: Host subprocess start failure error code
facts.value: ERR_HOST_START_FAILED — shell stays alive, enters failed state, troubleshooting guidance shown in-app (UF4)

facts.subject: Update feed unreachable error code
facts.value: ERR_UPDATE_FEED_UNREACHABLE — update check fails silently; no error dialog, no retry storm, startup not blocked

facts.subject: Non-whitelisted release URL rejection
facts.value: ERR_UPDATE_URL_REJECTED — openExternal rejected for URLs outside RELEASE_HOST allowlist; rejection logged; app continues normally

facts.subject: Single instance lock error code
facts.value: ERR_SINGLE_INSTANCE — second launch routed to running instance: window open → focus existing; tray-resident → restore from tray; no second host subprocess

facts.subject: Notification dedup window
facts.value: DEDUP_WINDOW_MS = 10000 — same session + same event type within 10s merges into one notification updated with latest content; click still focuses that session

facts.subject: Crash recovery backoff and terminal state
facts.value: BACKOFF_SCHEDULE_MS = [2000, 4000, 8000]; 3 attempts; exhaustion → failed state with failure code retry-exhausted (ERR_RECOVERY_RETRY_EXHAUSTED-shaped message, ≤120-char failure detail); no infinite retry, shell stays alive

facts.subject: Release URL allowlist
facts.value: RELEASE_HOST = 'github.com', RELEASE_PATH_PREFIX = '/bigfaner/dsh-forge/releases'; only matching URLs may open externally

facts.subject: Update banner state machine
facts.value: UpdateBannerPhase = hidden | queued | shown | dismissed; while UF4 recovery mask active a new banner transitions to queued and is shown when mask exits; already-shown banner stays shown under mask; dismissed is terminal until restart

facts.subject: Carrier protocol
facts.value: dsh-app:// custom protocol carries the upstream SPA; no listening port is opened

facts.subject: Shell IPC channel namespaces
facts.value: dshForge.update.* and dshForge.recovery.* IPC channels with sender validation (ERR_IPC_SENDER_REJECTED on invalid sender)

facts.subject: Profile directory isolation

facts.subject: i18n locale mechanism

facts.subject: Collision fixture build-time modes (ui-slots collision mechanics)
facts.value: hello-world-collision MODE: replica = same child key hello-world.panel distinct id, first declarer wins and second register call throws; coexist = own key collision-replica.panel, both panels merge into the list slot (control); shadow = same cell id at lower priority -1, layered takeover with previous occupant staying on the ledger; tie = same cell id at same priority 0, registry rejects with an explicit throw

facts.subject: Version-consistency gate comparison set

facts.subject: Artifact-level vendored scan and template manifest rules
facts.value: plugin build artifacts under lib/ (.js/.mjs/.cjs) must be vendor-free: any module specifier resolving into vendor trees (vendor/ or packages/desktop-host-vendor/), carrying a vendor path segment, or using file: protocol into the repo is red; manifest dependency specs declaring file:/link:/workspace: or bare in-repo paths are red for the same reason; templates expect no built lib/ but face the same manifest rules, MUST carry version-stamp.json, and MUST declare engines["@deepseek-ai/dsh"] exact == desktopHostVersion

facts.subject: Plugin engineering template manifest
facts.value: @dsh-forge/template-plugin (packages/templates/plugin): engines {"@deepseek-ai/dsh": "0.1.6-alpha.2"} (VS Code engines.vscode analog), exports["./client"], npm-form exact dependencies (no workspace:/link:/file: specs), dsh.client.inject = minimal stable subset (locale, ui-chat, ui-renderer)

facts.subject: Plugin tarball staging (packaging leg, config-driven)
facts.value: scripts/stage-plugin-tarballs.mjs: pnpm-pack the workspace plugins the product config references via tarball: sources and stage artifacts next to plugin-bundles.json in app resources (dev: apps/desktop/resources; packaged: electron-builder extraResources filter plugin-tarballs/**); staged filename must equal the config-declared basename — plugin version bump without config edit fails loud; --check verifies staged files exist; exit 0 success / 1 failure

facts.subject: live-ui-probe real-chain evidence collection flags
facts.value: scripts/acceptance/live-ui-probe.mjs runs the real vendored host subprocess + real web dist; --plugin-leg collects boot roster product plugin entries, [data-dsh-forge-plugin] panel DOM text, panel-only screenshots, and click -> store update -> re-render live check; --executable probes the packaged exe (win-unpacked); --offline-proxy attaches dead proxy 127.0.0.1:9 (all external HTTP fails = offline simulation; dsh-app:// custom protocol bypasses proxy); --artifacts-dir defaults to docs/features/ui-plugin-foundation/artifacts; exit 0 = probe completed, 1 = boot/UI wait failure

facts.subject: Spike report gate for M2 design
facts.value: docs/features/ui-plugin-foundation/spike-report.md: each of the three unverified items archived as conclusion + independent fallback two-column; distribution-form conclusion (spike-report §4.1) = tarball built-in + shell-side pre-seeding; source-level facts anchored to checkout SHA c36ba648 (0.1.6-alpha.2); journey pins the doc reference baseline at tech-direction commit 6f5b109 (2026-09-21)

facts.subject: Workbench IPC verb face channel inventory
facts.value: 16 whitelisted channels under dshForge.workbench.*: getState, registerProject, updateProject, removeProject, activateProject, getTaskBoard, getTaskDetail, getFeatureBoard, readFeatureDoc, listPlugins, setPluginEnabled, recordSessionLink, endSessionLink, authorizeExternalDocPath, plus subscribeEvents/unsubscribeEvents; one channel per verb, sender validation before service call

facts.subject: Workbench IPC error envelope
facts.value: WorkbenchErrorEnvelope {code, message, detail?}; reject serializes the envelope as the Error message (renderer parses back to object); errors carrying a domain ERR_* code pass through unchanged; unclassified exceptions fall back to ERR_WORKBENCH_DB with log

facts.subject: TaskSummary DTO dialect
facts.value: TaskSummary.key = qualified board address <featureSlug>/<localId>; blockers = same-feature local upstream keys (transitive chain expanded by getTaskDetail); branch nullable execution trace; worktree boolean; source = session|terminal|null; updatedAt timestamp

facts.subject: Task status vocabulary (7 states)
facts.value: task_snapshot.status constrained to pending, in_progress, completed, blocked, suspended, skipped, rejected; source column constrained to session or terminal; blockers stored as JSON array of direct upstream keys

facts.subject: Feature snapshot projection
facts.value: feature_snapshot.status is a manifest-vocabulary passthrough (prd/design/tasks/in-progress/completed); doc_kinds = JSON array subset of manifest/prd/design/ui/tasks; task_total and task_completed counts maintained per feature

facts.subject: Session link lifecycle semantics
facts.value: session_links UNIQUE(project_id, task_key, session_id); status active|ended; recordSessionLink = idempotent upsert (re-record refreshes started_at, resets to active, row id stable); endSessionLink sets ended without deleting rows (idempotent no-op when already ended); supersedeActiveSessionLinks ends other active rows of the same task keeping the keepSessionId row (launch-side convergence; no convergence at app exit); history listed newest-first by started_at including ended rows

facts.subject: Project registration repo semantics
facts.value: projects.code_root UNIQUE -> ERR_PROJECT_EXISTS on duplicate; display_name defaults to the code_root directory name when not provided; doc_location_type in_repo (path NULL) | external (path required); removeProject runs in an immediate transaction that clears the active_project_id pointer when it targets the removed project, with CASCADE deleting snapshots and session links; unknown id -> ERR_PROJECT_NOT_FOUND

facts.subject: Registration/repoint validation chain order and codes
facts.value: Chain order (rejection precedence): (1) input coherence shape errors -> plain Error; (2) code_root not a readable directory -> ERR_CODE_ROOT_UNREADABLE (message carries path and reason: does not exist / permission denied / not a directory); (3) external path equals own code_root, an existing project code_root, or an existing external doc path -> ERR_DOC_PATH_CONFLICT (pure db comparison, zero fs); (4) external path without recorded authorization -> ERR_EXTERNAL_PATH_UNREADABLE (checked before any fs probe of that path); (5) external path not readable -> ERR_EXTERNAL_PATH_UNREADABLE; (6) forge data not detected -> ERR_FORGE_NOT_DETECTED; (7) repos UNIQUE(code_root) -> ERR_PROJECT_EXISTS. updateProject repoint walks the same chain (edit mode has no authorization exemption); pure rename does no fs probing

facts.subject: Forge checkout detection rule
facts.value: forge data detected when a .forge directory or a docs/features directory exists under the effective doc location (in_repo -> codeRoot; external -> docLocationPath); the ERR_FORGE_NOT_DETECTED message names which probe is missing

facts.subject: getTaskPrompt probe gates and spawn shape
facts.value: Gate order: illegal task-key dialect -> ERR_NO_PROMPT with no spawn; projectRoot not in the registered-project allowlist -> ERR_NO_PROMPT; CLI resolution failure or spawn error -> ERR_FORGE_CLI_UNAVAILABLE; otherwise spawns 'forge prompt get-by-task-id <localId>' with cwd pinned to the registered root, 15s budget, 2MiB stdout cap, 256KiB stderr cap; nonzero exit (structured stderr), timeout, output overflow, or empty stdout -> ERR_NO_PROMPT; success returns the COMPLETE stdout untrimmed (promptText is byte-faithful)

facts.subject: Task key dialects
facts.value: local forge task id = digits separated by dots (source whitelist FORGE_TASK_KEY_PATTERN); board-qualified address = <featureSlug>/<localId> (used in IPC and session_links); spawn argv carries only the local id

facts.subject: SessionLaunch host chain contract
facts.value: launch input {promptText (complete getTaskPrompt stdout), title, cwd = registered codeRoot, sessionId?}; channel = in-process sessionController: create({sessionId, cwd}) idempotent-adopts a caller-minted session-<uuid> id, then prompt({requestId, sessionId, mode: 'queue', content}) persists the first user message; requestId deterministically derived by sha256 over sessionId + message (replays never double-post); failure reasonCodes: ERR_HOST_NOT_READY (channel absent; client tries tier 2) and ERR_SESSION_CHANNEL_UNAVAILABLE (create/prompt leg failed or exceeded the 10s per-leg hang guard; routes into the tier-3 fallback, never an error presentation); empty promptText or cwd is a caller contract rejection

facts.subject: UF5 launch degradation chain tiers
facts.value: tier 1 host channel -> tier 2 renderer ctx.remote.session retry (carries the tier-1 recovery sessionId for adopt + re-prompt) -> tier 3 frozen fallback (verbatim prompt to clipboard + main window fronted + manual-guidance toast); channel failures ROUTE down the chain and are never displayed as errors; only a denied clipboard or a thrown rejection resolves 'failed' (LaunchErrorDialog with clipboard-denied/unexpected copy and a retry entry)

facts.subject: UF5 entry probe and stage states
facts.value: mount-once getTaskPrompt probe: available -> trigger enabled with the byte-faithful cached promptText; ERR_NO_PROMPT or ERR_FORGE_CLI_UNAVAILABLE -> trigger disabled with a reason tooltip (launch.reason.noPrompt = 该任务没有执行 prompt,无法从它发起会话 / launch.reason.cliUnavailable), never an error surface; confirm panel shows the prompt preview default-collapsed with confirm as default focus (one click, 3s budget); trigger element carries data-probe and data-stage attributes; stages idle/confirm/degraded/failed/done; initiating indicator while the chain runs

facts.subject: Launch success-leg persistence order
facts.value: after a launched outcome: recordSessionLink({projectId, taskKey = qualified address, sessionId}) — a persistence hiccup is swallowed (the session is not un-launched); then onLaunched switches to the session view (uiWorkspace.openSession) and the task card shows the 会话运行中 badge; the launch-side supersede converges prior active links of the task

facts.subject: FORGE_ACTOR attribution and change-source determination
facts.value: first user message = verbatim prompt + ONE appended attribution instruction line (body never rewritten), actor value 'session:<sessionId>'; change-source order: path 1 record actor frontmatter 'session:' prefix -> session / literal 'terminal' -> terminal; path 2 fallback: task has an active session link -> session, otherwise terminal; judged only for changed rows (unchanged rows keep historical source)

facts.subject: WorkbenchEvent push shapes
facts.value: WorkbenchEvent = task_updated {projectId, taskKey, source, changeKind attribute|structural} | feature_updated {projectId, featureSlug} | sync {projectId, sync}; SyncStatusPayload = {state idle|scanning|error, lastScanAt, error?}; batched push on channel dsh-forge:workbench-events to subscribed live senders only; single-subscriber semantics per webContents (re-subscribe idempotent, destroy auto-unsubscribes)

facts.subject: File watcher orchestration budgets
facts.value: watch targets = codeRoot/.forge plus the effective docs/features (external doc location -> docLocationPath/docs/features); change batches debounced 400ms trailing; rescans scheduled via setTimeout(0) macro-task slicing (never on the fs callback stack); event batcher merges pushes within 500ms; only registered and authorized roots are watched (unauthorized external root excluded with a warn, other roots unaffected); activate switch = full watch rebuild (handles released); removeProject stops the chain with null

facts.subject: Plugin two-tier runtime projection
facts.value: PluginRow {name, mandatory, enabled}; mandatory derives from the build-time product manifest plugin-bundles.json (runtime read-only); enabled derives from <userData>/plugin-runtime.json whose schema is exactly {disabled: string[]} — a missing file is an empty overlay meaning all enabled; the overlay structurally excludes mandatory names (third-party only)

facts.subject: setPluginEnabled guard behavior
facts.value: guard runs before any overlay write: disable request for a mandatory bundle -> PluginMandatoryError with code ERR_PLUGIN_MANDATORY plus a structured log (UI renders no disable affordance = defense layer 1; the guard is layer 2); unknown plugin name -> plain contract error from the verb face; a successful write touches ONLY the overlay file (manifest bytes unchanged) and returns the refreshed PluginRow list

facts.subject: Plugin runtime overlay parse-time validation
facts.value: structurally malformed overlay (bad JSON, non-object root, unknown keys, missing/non-array disabled) -> original isolated as <name>.corrupt-<timestamp> and an empty overlay rebuilt, startup never blocked, ERR_PLUGIN_RUNTIME_STATE logged; schema-valid but violating entries (mandatory names, unknown names, non-strings) stripped in memory with an ERR_PLUGIN_RUNTIME_STATE log — the manifest state wins for those rows

facts.subject: External doc path authorization gate
facts.value: the authorizeExternalDocPath verb is the sole persistence channel for wizard step-2 explicit authorization; the validation chain checks the authorization record BEFORE any fs probe of the path (unauthorized external path -> ERR_EXTERNAL_PATH_UNREADABLE without probing); repoint/edit mode walks the same chain with no exemption

facts.subject: Source marking and link UI labels (zh locale)
facts.value: tasks.source.session = 会话; tasks.source.terminal = 终端; tasks.badge.sessionLive = 会话运行中; detail.links.active = 会话中; detail.links.enter = 进入会话; detail.links.empty = 该任务尚未挂接会话; launch.reason.noPrompt tooltip = 该任务没有执行 prompt,无法从它发起会话

facts.subject: View-key page addressing (no URL routes)
facts.value: no URL routing; pages addressed by session-memory view keys: workbench/overview (default tab), workbench/tasks, workbench/features (+ :slug detail subview), workbench/dialog/* overlays (wizard, remove confirm, plugin disable confirm, launch error), session (upstream view, UF5 jump target); equivalent gating = state gates (no active project -> overview empty state auto-enters wizard; invalid external doc -> error card + repoint guidance)

facts.subject: readFeatureDoc kind whitelist and tab gating
facts.value: readFeatureDoc kind must be one of manifest/prd/design/ui/tasks (shape error otherwise); FeatureSummary.docKinds lists only the kinds actually present and drives the UF4 doc-tab enabled/disabled state — missing kinds render disabled, never hidden; the five tab headers are always present

facts.subject: TaskDetail composition
facts.value: getTaskDetail returns summary + descriptionMarkdown (task file raw markdown for injection-safe read-only rendering) + depChain (transitive upstream blocker chain, topological order, qualified keys) + records (at/kind/source/summary adapted from the forge write-once record markdown, no fabricated fields) + links (session link history newest-first, ended rows included); per-task link history is the same lookup the source-inference fallback consumes

facts.subject: Sync status surface on the board
facts.value: TaskBoardData carries sync SyncStatusPayload {state idle|scanning|error, lastScanAt, error?}; sync_state.error caps the reason at 120 characters; on perception-chain failure the board presents the sync-error toolbar indication with silent retry and retains the last-good board; snapshots are rebuildable derived caches (forge files remain the sole source of truth)

facts.subject: M3 kernel 7-state transition table (TS port of Go statemachine)
facts.value: TRANSITION_TABLE = 23 ordered rules, first match decides; completed irreversible ('task already completed, create a subtask if re-work needed'); rejected/skipped reopen→pending only; only role submit may reach completed; suspended cannot go directly to completed; manual role may enter suspended and adjudicate from it; same-state transition is an allowed no-op; blocked→pending/in_progress for non-manual roles requires dependency check (phase 2)

facts.subject: claim vs transition dependency-check dialects
facts.value: claim: dangling exact dependencies are vacuously satisfied (filtered, not reported), resolved dependencies must be terminal (completed/skipped; rejected does not satisfy); dangling blocker words are stored verbatim. transition (manual role) blocked→pending/in_progress legs go through checkTransitionDeps where dangling = unmet (a separate Go check, kept separate in the port)

facts.subject: Kernel task write set requires sqlite authority
facts.value: all five task write verbs (taskAdd/taskClaim/taskTransition/taskSubmit/taskReopen) only open on projects with data_authority='sqlite'; files-authoritative projects → ERR_TASK_NOT_AUTHORITATIVE with an explicit 'use the forge CLI (dual-form discipline)' hint; decision lives in the kernel, never trusts tool input semantics

facts.subject: Task actor audit columns
facts.value: every kernel task write records task.updated_by (session:<id> | external | kernel | dispatcher) + updated_at; dsh tool face derives actor automatically from exec.agent session identity as 'session:<id>' and fails closed (throw) when identity is missing — never mis-records audit

facts.subject: One-shot migration pipeline phase order and atomicity
facts.value: phase order pinned: guard → backup → ingest → verify → switch → archive; ingest/verify/switch/archive run inside one transaction whose COMMIT lands after successful archive; any failure → ROLLBACK (db back to pre-migration state) + doc-tree restore (rename rollback, backup as fallback) + post-rollback audit rows written outside the transaction; retry is idempotent-successful (post-failure state ≡ pre-migration state)

facts.subject: Migration domain error codes and guard conditions
facts.value: closed set: ERR_MIGRATION_GUARD | ERR_MIGRATION_VERIFY | ERR_MIGRATION_IN_PROGRESS. Guard rejections: project missing; migration already in flight (ERR_MIGRATION_IN_PROGRESS); already migrated (data_authority='sqlite', one-shot, message tells to restore from backups first); running dispatches with ended_at IS NULL > 0 (PRD hard constraint: in-flight orchestration blocks migration). ERR_MIGRATION_VERIFY carries the full parity report

facts.subject: Migration backup artifact location and content
facts.value: backup lands at <userData>/workbench/backups/<projectId>-<ts>/ and contains the db file trio plus a copy of the doc tree tasks/ directories; backup phase runs before the transaction opens and leaves an audit row whether it succeeds or fails

facts.subject: index.json terminal archival
facts.value: archive = rename tasks/index.json → index.json.migrated-<ts> per feature (zero content rewrite, lexicographic order pinned); task and record markdown files (tasks/*.md, tasks/records/*.md) are never migrated or modified — they stay in place

facts.subject: migration_event audit table
facts.value: migration_event rows: phase ∈ backup|ingest|verify|switch|archive|rollback|reingest, result ∈ ok|fail, detail_json, at; time-ordered listing per project is the reviewable audit face; migration_progress events push each phase completion

facts.subject: External write reingest and deviation marking (T3)
facts.value: on a migrated project, any reproduced tasks/index.json under the doc tree is by existence an external write; per scan round: fingerprint (sha256 per slug set) dedupe against the last reingest audit; deviation = projects.deviated=1 set before reingest commits (kept on failure) + deviation_detected event; reingest = single transaction delete-then-insert per feature + parity verify, failure → full ROLLBACK + fail audit with reason; the reproduced file stays in place (external session never blocked); un-migrated (files) projects short-circuit with zero behavior change

facts.subject: dispatch table contract
facts.value: dispatch row: state ∈ starting|running|awaiting|failed|done (CHECK), session_id NULL until backfilled, prompt_hash = sha256(combined first message) NOT NULL, actor (human dispatcher), batch_id aggregates one dispatch batch, ended_at IS NULL = in-flight (migration guard reads this); one row per task per batch

facts.subject: Dispatchable task set and per-status hints
facts.value: dispatchable statuses = pending | blocked; resolved dependencies must be terminal (claim dialect: dangling vacuously satisfied → filtered from the unmet list); rejections: completed → 'already completed — create a subtask', in_progress → 'one executor per task', suspended → 'resume before dispatching', rejected → 'reopen it before dispatching'; taskKeys must be distinct, non-empty board addresses; whole batch is validated atomically before any row is written

facts.subject: Stage artifacts missing = warning + acknowledge face, zero rows
facts.value: checkStageArtifacts outcome consumed by dispatch: missing items present and acknowledgeMissing not set → return {blocked:'artifacts-missing', missing} with zero dispatch rows (warn does not hard-block — the acknowledge flag expresses informed continuation); acknowledgeMissing=true proceeds to dispatch

facts.subject: Presynthesis contract check before dispatch
facts.value: every dispatched task must carry non-empty presynthesized injection content and a finalized hash; empty/absent presynth (engine not wired or empty output) or empty pre-minted sessionId → ERR_SYSTEM_PROMPT_CONTRACT, refusing to dispatch (zero rows)

facts.subject: Presynthesis three-element composition
facts.value: three elements assembled deterministically (no eval, no model calls): (1) task-type protocol = PROMPT_TEMPLATES routing over task.task_type with surface-suffix fallback to system base types + EXECUTOR_PREAMBLE wrapper; (2) feature goal/summary = latest stage_asset path (stages/<stage>.md, candidates exclude the feature's current stage, empty set → PhaseSummary block omitted entirely); (3) effective prefs = resolveEffectiveValues (feature>project>global; coverage.<task-type> drives coverage instructions; cleanup/refactor forced to maintain). Product = EXECUTOR_PREAMBLE + rendered protocol; combined first message = content + blank line + attribution line; prompt_hash = sha256(combined message); compose mints a fresh pre-minted session-<uuid> per call so hash is decoupled from launch

facts.subject: Presynthesis type routing rejections
facts.value: ERR_TASK_TYPE_UNKNOWN: empty task_type or no template match (no exact hit, no strippable surface suffix, or base type not a system type); ERR_TASK_TYPE_NOT_DISPATCHABLE: dispatch-restricted 5 types (skill not carried until M4) and 2 mechanism-replaced types (stage gate / stage summary own the protocol) — template in library but dispatch closed

facts.subject: Dispatch host callbacks (state machine edges)
facts.value: notifySessionStarted: starting→running with session_id backfill (idempotent no-op for the same session); notifyLaunchFailed: starting→failed + reason; notifyDispatchEnded: running|awaiting→done|failed with a hard guard — awaiting may not end while pending approvals > 0 (no implicit decisions); all transitions land in kernel transactions, illegal edges rejected with ERR_DISPATCH_STATE_INVALID; events dispatch_updated emitted per change

facts.subject: Approval routing and decision semantics
facts.value: approval_request rows: state pending|approved|rejected, decided_by/decided_at audit, payload_json carries request body, session_id = source subagent session; receiveApproval accepts only from running/awaiting dispatches (running→awaiting + first pending insert in one transaction; ERR_DISPATCH_STATE_INVALID otherwise — nothing dropped silently); decideApproval is an explicit human decision — repeat decision → ERR_APPROVAL_DECIDED, missing → ERR_APPROVAL_NOT_FOUND; deciding the last pending approval moves awaiting→running in the same transaction; approval_received events emitted on arrival

facts.subject: Redispatch semantics
facts.value: redispatch accepts only failed dispatch rows (ERR_DISPATCH_STATE_INVALID otherwise); re-runs the full check chain (artifacts missing → blocked return, no rows); the original failed row stays as the audit trail, the new dispatch gets a new row; UI requires a second confirmation

facts.subject: Three-tier prefs storage model
facts.value: single prefs table scoped global|project|feature; feature scope_id = '<projectId>/<featureSlug>' (prevents cross-project slug collisions); closed key registry (auto.* ModeToggles + gitPush + eval booleans, worktree.source-branch text, coverage.<task-type> strategies, eval.* numbers) — surfaces and structural keys excluded; unknown key → ERR_PREF_KEY_UNKNOWN, type violation → ERR_PREF_VALUE_INVALID; type metadata exposed via getPrefs (UI never hardcodes the key list)

facts.subject: Prefs effective-value resolution chain
facts.value: resolution walks feature > project > global; first explicit row wins; no explicit row anywhere → registry authoritative default (source='default'); worktree.* has no default → value null; getPrefs rows carry value/source/override/localValue so the editor and the dispatch consumer share one source

facts.subject: setPrefs atomicity
facts.value: setPrefs validates the entire entry list first (key set + type normalization; failure → zero writes) then writes all rows in one transaction — mid-flight failure rolls the whole batch back (no partial persistence); success emits prefs_updated

facts.subject: clearPrefOverride idempotence
facts.value: clearPrefOverride deletes the local override row; idempotent no-op when the row is absent and emits no event when nothing changed; effective value falls back to the next tier; key outside the registry → same ERR_PREF_KEY_UNKNOWN as setPrefs

facts.subject: Stage gate rule
facts.value: gate = stages/<current-stage>.md exists (live fs check identical in getStageGate and advanceStage — never trusts index staleness); unsatisfied advance → ERR_STAGE_GATE_UNSATISFIED with a missing-artifact guidance message naming the expected path and the producing tool; stage pipeline vocabulary = prd → design → tasks → in-progress → completed

facts.subject: advanceStage kernel-write and idempotence semantics
facts.value: advanceStage is the kernel's only manifest status writer (in-place status replace, other fields/body preserved; missing manifest → minimal one created; malformed YAML → ERR_STAGE_MANIFEST_UNREADABLE refusing to merge); already completed → idempotent no-op (zero writes, zero events); successful advance writes manifest + feature_snapshot pair, clears feature deviation (last_external_at kept as audit), emits stage_advanced; a repeat advance after success hits the new stage's unsatisfied gate (observable rejection, not silent)

facts.subject: stageSummarize single-canonical-file discipline
facts.value: stageSummarize writes features/<slug>/stages/<stage>.md with frontmatter {stage, generated (kernel-minted ISO), goal} + summary body; same-stage rewrite = overwrite update (T4 single canonical file); stage value outside the vocabulary or empty goal/summary → ERR_STAGE_ASSET_INVALID; after write the stage_asset index is replaced synchronously using the same collector as perception (zero index lag)

facts.subject: checkStageArtifacts determinism and cumulative matrix
facts.value: deterministic code only — file existence + frontmatter/structure parsing + SQLite state queries, zero model calls (import-surface whitelist pinned by tests); expectation matrix is cumulative per stage (design row = prd row + design delta): manifest presence/status, prd/prd-spec.md, design/ ≥1 md, tasks/ ≥1 md + non-empty SQLite task set + dependency references closed, ≥1 dispatched (in_progress|completed) task with non-empty md description, all-terminal tasks + stages/<prd|design|tasks|in-progress>.md assets; missing items = warning list, never an exception

facts.subject: stage_asset index table
facts.value: stage_asset PK (project_id, feature_slug, stage), stage ∈ prd|design|tasks|in-progress|completed, content stays in doc-root files stages/<stage>.md — the table is a rebuildable derived index (metadata only: path, generated_at)

facts.subject: Feature-level deviation detection
facts.value: before each perception scan: live manifest frontmatter status ≠ pre-scan feature_snapshot.status → external change → feature_snapshot.deviated=1 + last_external_at + deviation_detected event; snapshot-less features / missing or corrupt manifest / out-of-vocabulary status → zero signal, no error; after detection the scan converges the snapshot to the manifest (same external change reported once); marker persists until the next kernel-legal advanceStage (which clears it); presentation only — zero blocking interaction, detection failure only logs ERR_WORKBENCH_DEVIATION

facts.subject: Proposal board read-only contract
facts.value: exactly two read verbs (getProposalBoard, readProposalDoc), zero write verbs in the domain; proposal_snapshot status ∈ draft|accepted|rejected|superseded, feature_slug NULL = unlinked (no badge rendered); hasEval = live fs check of proposals/<slug>/eval/*.md per read (never trusts index staleness); board sort = created descending, tie → slug ascending (forge-cli Discover baseline); project missing → ERR_PROJECT_NOT_FOUND, bad slug shape → ERR_PROPOSAL_PATH_INVALID, missing file/eval → ERR_PROPOSAL_NOT_FOUND; proposal_snapshot rows sync with each perception scan, reusing the sync event batch

facts.subject: Workbench verb channel whitelist (M3 additions)
facts.value: one channel per verb dsh-forge:workbench-<kebab-verb>, additive-only; M3 adds: 7 task verbs (add/claim/transition/submit/reopen/get/query), 2 migration (getMigrationStatus/startMigration), 2 probes (probeCodeRoot/getWorkbenchPaths), 6 knowledge+feature, 3 prefs, 3 stages read (checkStageArtifacts/getStageGate/listStageAssets), 2 stages write (advanceStage/stageSummarize), 2 proposals, 5 dispatch, 3 host callbacks (receiveApproval/notifySessionStarted/notifyLaunchFailed); event push is a separate main→renderer channel, never invokable

facts.subject: dsh model-facing tool inventory (18 flat snake_case)
facts.value: forge_task_add / forge_task_claim / forge_task_get / forge_task_list / forge_task_query / forge_task_reopen / forge_task_submit / forge_task_transition / forge_fact / forge_lesson / forge_research / forge_forensic / forge_feature_list / forge_feature_status / forge_pref_get / forge_stage_summarize / forge_proposal_list / forge_proposal_show; flat underscore names (provider charset rejects dots); strict typed schemas + status enums; taskKey whitelist = board address double-gate; actor auto-derived from session identity, missing → fail-closed throw

facts.subject: Tool result semantics and degradation
facts.value: kernel values and business rejections return as canonical JSON values (ok:false + code + message — a business hint, not error noise); only bridge transport failure after retry = ERR_TOOL_BRIDGE_UNAVAILABLE thrown up into the session as an explicit degradation notice (never silent); actor missing = throw (audit discipline)

facts.subject: customSkillDirs skill carriage (15 flat-name skills)
facts.value: 15 skill directories under packages/plugins/forge-workbench/resources/skills: submit-task, git-commit, git-checkout, run-tests, fix-bug, test-guide, brainstorm, write-prd, tech-design, ui-design, breakdown-tasks, quick-tasks, gen-contracts, gen-journeys, gen-test-scripts; app boot writes the skill root into the app-owned host profile user layer (<profileDir>/cordis.patch.yml, id: skill-filesystem row, config.customSkillDirs) before supervisor.startHost; three defenses: install-dir prefix validation, drift repair (missing/duplicate/stale entries + manifest hash marker), explicit non-silent failure ERR_SKILL_DIR_SYNC surfaced as settings alerts; user-owned entries outside the prefix preserved byte-for-byte

facts.subject: Dispatch launch contract (host half)
facts.value: launch input requires non-empty prompt + finalized prompt_hash (either missing → refuse start, dispatch row goes failed); create({sessionId, cwd=registered codeRoot}) is caller-minted idempotent adopt; prompt({mode:'queue'}) delivers the combined first message character-for-character (zero rewrite) as a persisted user message; each leg runs under a hang ceiling; failure reasons route to the dispatch failed state, never an unhandled error

facts.subject: Workbench tab order incl. proposals tab
facts.value: WORKBENCH_TABS = [workbench/overview, workbench/proposals, workbench/features, workbench/tasks] — proposals tab second (PRD Navigation Architecture); pages addressed by session-memory view keys, no URL routes

facts.subject: Authoritative task write events (sqlite projects)
facts.value: kernel authoritative writes emit task_updated events directly (single batch per verb) — the board's ≤5s no-manual-refresh backflow on migrated projects depends on this direct push because perception scans only cover files projects; presynth consumed at dispatch time (already-launched subagent prompts are never retro-rewritten)

facts.subject: M3 event vocabulary and push channel
facts.value: v2 event types include task_updated, feature_updated, sync, dispatch_updated, approval_received, deviation_detected, migration_progress, stage_advanced, prefs_updated; batches coalesced ≤500ms on main→renderer channel dsh-forge:workbench-events (main is sole sender; renderer subscribes)

facts.subject: Default doc root = app-managed out-of-repo path
facts.value: getWorkbenchPaths returns docsRoot = the out-of-repo app-managed default doc root (G7/SC9 wizard default flip) and backupsRoot = migration backup root; wizard doc-location step defaults to external with in-repo as an explicit option; external paths require the persisted authorization record (authorizeExternalDocPath is the sole write channel; validation chain checks the record before any fs probe)

facts.subject: ForgeBridge spawn-CLI chain retired
facts.value: the M2 ForgeBridge (spawn forge CLI for prompt synthesis) is deleted; the presynthesized prompt replaces forge prompt; plugin host half contains zero CLI spawn sites; per journey invariants the forge CLI invocation count over an app-channel pipeline is zero (process/log-level assertion)

facts.subject: v2 schema M3 additions summary
facts.value: v2 = 2 ALTER groups (projects: data_authority files|sqlite + deviated + migrated_at + backup_path; feature_snapshot: deviated + last_external_at) + 7 new tables (task, dispatch, approval_request, prefs, stage_asset, proposal_snapshot, migration_event) + 6 indexes; only-add carrier discipline (all v1 tables/columns survive); WAL + foreign_keys per connection

facts.subject: workbench IPC verb whitelist size and M4 additions
facts.value: 62 verbs on dsh-forge:workbench-<kebab> channels; M4 additions: probeProjectPath, renameProject, archiveProject, restoreProject, listProjects, retryProjection, getProjectionStatus, submitWorkspaceSnapshot, reportProjectionOutcome, getProjectUiState, setProjectUiState

facts.subject: window role typed handshake (detached boot)
facts.value: WindowRole = {kind:'main'} | {kind:'detached', windowId, projectId, view, target?}; supplied by main-process registry matched on webContents id, never via URL; unknown sender -> null (renderer falls back to main semantics)

facts.subject: detached window title format
facts.value: 「<项目名> · <视图名>[ · 已归档]」; archived suffix rides only the title (window stays usable)

facts.subject: detached window default geometry
facts.value: 960x640 centered on main window for the first detached window; priority = replay rect > in-process remembered geometry > default

facts.subject: OS close equivalence with recall
facts.value: OS title-bar close and windowRecall converge on the same 'closed' orchestration: registry removal + detached-closed event exactly once; 'close' remembers geometry

facts.subject: window management error codes
facts.value: ERR_WINDOW_NOT_FOUND (windowId invalid at recall) / ERR_WINDOW_OPEN_FAILED (construction throw or document load failure -> recall the window)

facts.subject: detached window lifecycle hooks
facts.value: recallAllForProject(projectId) on project removal; recallAll() on main-window close (app quit); setProjectArchived refreshes live window titles immediately (restore clears)

facts.subject: lineage computation budget and degrade
facts.value: LINEAGE_BUDGET_MS=100 cooperative deadline (checkpoint every 64 nodes); degrade reasons snapshot-absent / budget-expired; degrade is silent to the user with one structured log line [forge-lineage] degraded; next call auto-recovers (pure recompute)

facts.subject: lineage descendant display cap
facts.value: LINEAGE_DESCENDANT_LIMIT=20 — descendant list renders up to the cap, tail shows the 「查看全部」 fold (必答⑥); overflow never breaks the parent-tree folding

facts.subject: lineage derivation purity
facts.value: click-time read-only derivation joining upstream ctx.sessions (byId + subagentsByParent) with kernel session_links; no standing index, no persistence, no write path; address authority = SubagentListEntry mode triple

facts.subject: Interface 6 session open channel
facts.value: openSessionTarget accepts a TOP session id or a SubagentAddress triple (mode member verbatim); openSessionTargetAside opens a right-column pane without view switch; rejections carry ERR_SESSION_OPEN_FAILED surfaced by the C5 open-failed toast (never silent)

facts.subject: C6 subagent session metadata bar states
facts.value: bound (unique lineage hit: task key/title/status Pill + 查看任务 ghost, click jumps to C5 dock) / ambiguous (multi-task session: 该会话执行中 secondary text, no task number, no jump) / unbound (renders nothing); lineage authoritative, naming auxiliary (silent correction by construction); seat = conversation.input.dock above composer

facts.subject: C5 task-detail dock contract
facts.value: right-edge dock min(440px,45vw) on window host / min(440px,100%) on pane host, z100, slide-in, NO mask (board stays interactive); focus trap with Esc/✕/outside-pointerdown close + focus return; task switch keeps detail up with aria-busy (no flicker)

facts.subject: C5 link-history section shape
facts.value: 挂接历史 accordion: active/ended links ordered 新→旧 (newest first); ended rows expandable; M4 enhancement rides inside: row expand shows lineage descendants + [打开] dual channel (top/subagent) + No-link [发起] entry

facts.subject: rightbar forge tab-kind whitelist
facts.value: TabKind = 'guide' | 'overview' | 'board' | 'doc' | 'depgraph' (five kinds; the same enum the project layout blob replays)

facts.subject: C9 split ratio clamp
facts.value: SPLIT_RATIO_MIN=0.3 / SPLIT_RATIO_MAX=0.7; clampSplitRatio bounds every drag/keyboard step (ArrowLeft/Right step); no pane shrinks below the readable minimum

facts.subject: session group overflow fold threshold
facts.value: TREE_OVERFLOW_LIMIT=5 — per-group sessions beyond 5 fold into 「展开其余 N 个会话」; overflowOpen state rides the layout memory

facts.subject: layout write debounce
facts.value: LAYOUT_WRITE_DEBOUNCE_MS=800 trailing write coalesces drag bursts into ONE setProjectUiState; project switch flushes the OLD project immediately (write-on-leave) then resets fragments and replays the new

facts.subject: layout forget-before-remove ordering
facts.value: forget(projectId) cancels the removed project pending write + drops fragments BEFORE the removeProject verb, so no debounced write can resurrect a cascaded project_ui_state row

facts.subject: no-row default layout semantics
facts.value: getProjectUiState answers {layout: default blob, stored:false} for a project with no project_ui_state row; stored !== true -> NOTHING replays (SC7 fix-2: default blob never publishes an empty tree over the activation auto-expand)

facts.subject: ProjectLayout v1 blob shape
facts.value: {version:1, sidebar:{collapsed, width?}, tree:{expandedProjects, expandedSessions, overflowOpen}, rightbar:{widthPct?, panes:[{tabs:[{kind, topic?}]}]}, detached:[{view, target?, rect?}]}

facts.subject: layout numeric bands
facts.value: widthPct = ratio x 100 clamped to [30,70]; sidebar width band [264,420] px (out-of-band width omitted)

facts.subject: layout blob whitelist boundaries
facts.value: tab kinds outside the five forge kinds (subagentchat/terminal/browser) have NO v1 slot and are dropped; a doc tab persists only with a resolvable topic (<=512 chars); depgraph topic optional; 分组×排序 view options NEVER enter the blob

facts.subject: layout replay operation sequence
facts.value: replay = ordered open ops: sidebar-width -> sidebar-collapse -> open-tab per pane (later panes first tab preferNewPane) -> split-ratio (only with >=2 panes) -> open-detached (rect rides); per-op guarded (one degraded op never aborts the rest); invalid blob kernel-sanitized to default (empty plan); 恢复态 = 离开前布局

facts.subject: projection state machine
facts.value: 4 states pending/healthy/degraded/deviation over a full 4x4 transition matrix; push_succeeded -> healthy (idempotent re-push converges deviation too), push_failed -> degraded, reconcile_drift -> deviation (present-only), reconcile_match -> healthy; unknown combos keep current state

facts.subject: reconcile verdict bridge
facts.value: diff verdict match -> reconcile_match, drift -> reconcile_drift; unprojected and archived -> no transition

facts.subject: projection relay execution order
facts.value: plan execution order: ensure (sort_order asc) -> rename -> reorder (insertBefore chain, tail-to-head) -> delete; a single op failure does not abort the stream; upstream 'workspace/not-found' on delete folds as success; vendored create takes no title (ensure title converges via conditional rename)

facts.subject: projection channel-absent semantics
facts.value: relay absent at push -> retry once -> still absent -> degraded with ERR_PROJECTION_CHANNEL_UNAVAILABLE in last_error, plan retained; retryProjection = idempotent full re-push (single plan converges all expectations incl. forge-subset relative order); archived projects and vanished rows skip

facts.subject: projection outcome error mapping
facts.value: upstream codes workspace/invalid-path | name-conflict | move-invalid -> ERR_PROJECTION_OP_FAILED (detail carries the original code); unlisted codes pass through; ok outcome -> recordSuccessfulPush + push_succeeded -> healthy; project row already gone -> terminal no-op + log

facts.subject: projection fault-injection seam
facts.value: DSH_FORGE_PROJECTION_FAULTS env carries a control-file path; vocabulary includes channel:'unavailable' (e2e degrade leg); defaults off in every shipped boot

facts.subject: registerProject hard checks
facts.value: exactly 2: anchor exists + directory + readable -> else ERR_CODE_ROOT_UNREADABLE; cross-project unique via D11 identity (canonical -> pathKey -> (dev,ino)) -> else ERR_PROJECT_EXISTS carrying fast-lane payload {projectId, displayName, codeRoot, tier} (hit also self-heals stale storage keys)

facts.subject: docsPlacement mapping
facts.value: repo-existing / repo-new -> (in_repo, NULL; repo-new lazy-materializes <anchor>/docs); app -> (external, kernel-derived <docsRoot>/<folder>, mkdir idempotent, no authorization needed); custom -> (external, docsPath) requires authorization on file (ERR_EXTERNAL_PATH_UNREADABLE) + readability + conflict checks

facts.subject: probeProjectPath DetectReport shape
facts.value: {canonicalPath (realpath.native), pathKey (win32-folded), identity(dev,ino), exists, isDir, readable, registered fast-lane {projectId, displayName}, gitRoot (top-level .git), forgeTreeHit (<root>/docs/features + manifest.md), childRepos (chips only when >=2)}; entry-rejected input -> zero-fs-facts report

facts.subject: confirm-card phase machine
facts.value: CardPhase priority: invalid-entry (empty | relative | bare-drive-or-root) > registered fast lane > missing (not-exists | not-dir | unreadable) > parent (>=2 childRepos) > valid (gitRoot present) > nogit (informational, not an error); EvidenceTier = repo-existing | repo-new | app

facts.subject: project lifecycle verb semantics
facts.value: renameProject = pure DB rename + projection rename plan push (local effect never blocked by projection failure); archiveProject = archived=1 (dsh workspace kept, zero projection ops); restoreProject = archived=0 (projection unchanged); removeProject = buildRemovalPlan BEFORE row delete + FK cascade + detached-window closes; listProjects v3 columns archived/sortOrder/projectionState/docsPlacement in registration order

facts.subject: active project pointer
facts.value: active_project_id lives in a single app_state row (at most one); project removal clears the pointer in the same transaction (no auto-activate of the next project); getState exposes activeProjectId: string | null

facts.subject: workbench event batch channel payloads
facts.value: main->renderer events coalesce on dsh-forge:workbench-events (<=500ms); M4 payloads: project_list_changed, projection_push_required {projectId, plan}, projection_updated (state transitions + deviation rows); window events detached-opened / detached-closed on dsh-forge:window-changed
